prose_evidence.text_as_printed: The Blood Mage is very unique class, and it has a very varied playstyle. One of the most unique spell-lines the class gets is the Symbiotes. Symbiotes are created by the Blood Mage by using his own blood and organs harvested from enemies, and subsequently cast on allies or yourself for various buffs. Do not expect your Symbiotes to be huge buffs; they give you a ton of flexibility and are very interesting. This document will cover the following topics: Construction of Symbiotes, Using Symbiotes and a List of the Symbiotes a Blood Mage will learn to use (and when).
prose_evidence.source_html:
The Blood Mage is very unique class, and it has a very varied playstyle. One of the most unique spell-lines the class gets is the Symbiotes.
Symbiotes are created by the Blood Mage by using his own blood and organs harvested from enemies, and subsequently cast on allies or yourself for various buffs.
Do not expect your Symbiotes to be huge buffs; they give you a ton of flexibility and are very interesting.
This document will cover the following topics: Construction of Symbiotes, Using Symbiotes and a List of the Symbiotes a Blood Mage will learn to use (and when).

prose_evidence.text_as_printed: When you get your first Symbiote-spell you will see that it requires a Symbiote-item to cast. To construct a Symbiote, follow these steps:
prose_evidence.source_html: When you get your first Symbiote-spell you will see that it requires a Symbiote-item to cast. To construct a Symbiote, follow these steps:

prose_evidence.text_as_printed: Note that there is no need for you to be at an assembly table!
prose_evidence.source_html: Note that there is no need for you to be at an assembly table!

prose_evidence.text_as_printed: Cast “Siphon Blood”, this will give you the “Vial of Blood” you need for constructing your new Symbiotes.
prose_evidence.source_html: • Cast “Siphon Blood”, this will give you the “Vial of Blood” you need for constructing your new Symbiotes.

prose_evidence.text_as_printed: Cast “Bursting Cyst”, “Exploding Cyst”, “Constrict”, “Union of Blood” or “Blood Letting Ritual” on a mob, any rank will do.
prose_evidence.source_html: • Cast “Bursting Cyst”, “Exploding Cyst”, “Constrict”, “Union of Blood” or “Blood Letting Ritual” on a mob, any rank will do.

prose_evidence.text_as_printed: While the mob is affected by the spell you cast on it, cast “Grim Harvest”, depending on which spell you cast you will get the following organ for your Symbiotes: “Bursting Cyst” or “Exploding Cyst”: Quivering Brain “Constrict”: Twitching Muscle “Union of Blood”: Still Beating Heart “Blood Letting Ritual”: Pulsating Stomach
prose_evidence.source_html:
• While the mob is affected by the spell you cast on it, cast “Grim Harvest”, depending on which spell you cast you will get the following organ for your Symbiotes:
    • “Bursting Cyst” or “Exploding Cyst”: Quivering Brain
    • “Constrict”: Twitching Muscle
    • “Union of Blood”: Still Beating Heart
    • “Blood Letting Ritual”: Pulsating Stomach

prose_evidence.text_as_printed: Open your Crafting list and go to the assembly-pane. In the pull-down menu select Blood Mage.
prose_evidence.source_html: • Open your Crafting list and go to the assembly-pane. In the pull-down menu select Blood Mage.

prose_evidence.text_as_printed: Find the Symbiote you want to construct, check if you have all the components (If not go get them as per steps 1-3).
prose_evidence.source_html: • Find the Symbiote you want to construct, check if you have all the components (If not go get them as per steps 1-3).

prose_evidence.text_as_printed: If you have all the components, click Combine and get your Symbiotes!
prose_evidence.source_html: • If you have all the components, click Combine and get your Symbiotes!

prose_evidence.text_as_printed: You should now have 10 of the Symbiote you constructed, and a few less components. No worries though; components stack, and a Still Beating Heart will continue beating even though you’ve had it in your bags for weeks.
prose_evidence.source_html: You should now have 10 of the Symbiote you constructed, and a few less components. No worries though; components stack, and a Still Beating Heart will continue beating even though you’ve had it in your bags for weeks.

prose_evidence.text_as_printed: Getting the organs you need can be a bit tricky, so heres some comments and tip. First of all, don’t harvest organs when you’re in a group. You’ll divert your attention from the action and that could prove fatal. Since organs stack (up to 20) go find some mobs (even gray ones will do), and harvest off those by yourself. I find that going into “Sanguine Focus” makes it easier to harvest several organs from the same mob since you wont do as much damage and wont take as much damage while waiting for “Grim Harvest” to refresh (15 seconds). I do this since you can harvest several organs off the same mob – yes, a bear does seem to have 4 brains, 3 hearts and more stomachs than a cow! Also you can make absolutely sure which organ to get by having only one debuff on the mob at one given time (so don’t cast Cyst followed immediately by Union of Blood, since you cant be sure which organ you’ll get).
prose_evidence.source_html:
Getting the organs you need can be a bit tricky, so heres some comments and tip.
First of all, don’t harvest organs when you’re in a group. You’ll divert your attention from the action and that could prove fatal.
Since organs stack (up to 20) go find some mobs (even gray ones will do), and harvest off those by yourself.
I find that going into “Sanguine Focus” makes it easier to harvest several organs from the same mob since you wont do as much damage and wont take as much damage while waiting for “Grim Harvest” to refresh (15 seconds).
I do this since you can harvest several organs off the same mob – yes, a bear does seem to have 4 brains, 3 hearts and more stomachs than a cow!
Also you can make absolutely sure which organ to get by having only one debuff on the mob at one given time (so don’t cast Cyst followed immediately by Union of Blood, since you cant be sure which organ you’ll get).

prose_evidence.text_as_printed: Vial of Blood: Not quite an organ, but deserves mention. Go into “Sanguine Focus” (for the HP regen), then cast on yourself “Transfusion of Serak” (for more HP) and then just go nuts with “Siphon Blood”. Just remember that you can kill yourself with “Siphon Blood” so take it easy when you go low on HP.
prose_evidence.source_html: • Vial of Blood: Not quite an organ, but deserves mention. Go into “Sanguine Focus” (for the HP regen), then cast on yourself “Transfusion of Serak” (for more HP) and then just go nuts with “Siphon Blood”. Just remember that you can kill yourself with “Siphon Blood” so take it easy when you go low on HP.

prose_evidence.text_as_printed: Quivering Brain: Easiest organ to harvest – cast a Cyst-spell followed by Grim Harvest.
prose_evidence.source_html: • Quivering Brain: Easiest organ to harvest – cast a Cyst-spell followed by Grim Harvest.

prose_evidence.text_as_printed: Still Beating Heart: Cast “Union of Blood” and then “Grim Harvest”.
prose_evidence.source_html: • Still Beating Heart: Cast “Union of Blood” and then “Grim Harvest”.

prose_evidence.text_as_printed: Twitching Muscle: Root the mob with “Constrict” , and then cast “Grim Harvest”. If root doesn’t break (“Grim Harvest” does cause a little damage), you can just wait until “Grim Harvest” refreshes and cast it again for another muscle.
prose_evidence.source_html: • Twitching Muscle: Root the mob with “Constrict” , and then cast “Grim Harvest”. If root doesn’t break (“Grim Harvest” does cause a little damage), you can just wait until “Grim Harvest” refreshes and cast it again for another muscle.

prose_evidence.text_as_printed: Pulsating Stomach: Build up 1 Blood Union Point with either “Despoil”, “Entwining Vein” or from “Focus of Gelenia” (Using these spells does not work with “Grim Harvest”, so they wont mess up which organ you get). Then cast “Blood Letting Ritual”, followed by “Grim Harvest”. The Duration on “Blood Letting Ritual” is long (1 minute), so you’ll be able to get 3 or 4 stomachs off the same mob (if the mob lives that long of course).
prose_evidence.source_html: • Pulsating Stomach: Build up 1 Blood Union Point with either “Despoil”, “Entwining Vein” or from “Focus of Gelenia” (Using these spells does not work with “Grim Harvest”, so they wont mess up which organ you get). Then cast “Blood Letting Ritual”, followed by “Grim Harvest”. The Duration on “Blood Letting Ritual” is long (1 minute), so you’ll be able to get 3 or 4 stomachs off the same mob (if the mob lives that long of course).

prose_evidence.text_as_printed: The points here is of course that having only one debuff on the mob ensures that you get exactly the organ you want, and that you can harvest several organs from one mob. Of course this is only my way of doing it, but I think its a very easy and quick way to get a lot of organs.

The points here is of course that having only one debuff on the mob ensures that you get exactly the organ you want, and that you can harvest several organs from one mob.
Of course this is only my way of doing it, but I think its a very easy and quick way to get a lot of organs.

prose_evidence.text_as_printed: When you have constructed your new Symbiotes, you can cast the spells associated with them. When you cast the spell your Defensive Target will be buffed with the Symbiote and one Symbiote of the appropriate type will be removed from your inventory. Remember that a player can only be buffed with one Symbiote at a time. The only offensive Symbiote is “Controlling Symbiote”. Casting it will apply it to your Offensive Target. Remember that the spell can miss, be resisted or just not work if the target is of a type that is not charmable or is to powerful (4dots and up usually). If you try to charm a mob which has already been charmed by “Controlling Symbiote” once, it will also fail. It does not cost you anything to construct or cast Symbiotes, the only cost you have is in getting the components.

The only offensive Symbiote is “Controlling Symbiote”. Casting it will apply it to your Offensive Target. Remember that the spell can miss, be resisted or just not work if the target is of a type that is not charmable or is to powerful (4dots and up usually). If you try to charm a mob which has already been charmed by “Controlling Symbiote” once, it will also fail.
It does not cost you anything to construct or cast Symbiotes, the only cost you have is in getting the components.

prose_evidence.text_as_printed: The blood mage can perform experiments on living tissue in order to make symbiotic creatures to live on himself or his allies. When you have a symbiote attached to you, you gain whatever abilities the corresponding symbiote grants. (You can cast these abilities as if they were granted to you by your class trainer, for a period of time)
prose_evidence.source_html: The blood mage can perform experiments on living tissue in order to make symbiotic creatures to live on himself or his allies. When you have a symbiote attached to you, you gain whatever abilities the corresponding symbiote grants. (You can cast these abilities as if they were granted to you by your class trainer, for a period of time)

prose_evidence.text_as_printed: The process of creating a symbiote is somewhat disturbing. It requires a fresh organ and a vial of your own blood. Once these two things are combined, depending on the organ, you will receive a symbiote.
prose_evidence.source_html: The process of creating a symbiote is somewhat disturbing. It requires a fresh organ and a vial of your own blood. Once these two things are combined, depending on the organ, you will receive a symbiote.

prose_evidence.text_as_printed: As your Blood Mage grows in power you will be able to create many more symbiotes. Refer to your ability page under crafting: assembly to find what symbiotes you can create.
prose_evidence.source_html: As your Blood Mage grows in power you will be able to create many more symbiotes. Refer to your ability page under crafting: assembly to find what symbiotes you can create.

prose_evidence.text_as_printed: Harvests an organ out of a living body. Harvests different organs based on what your opponent has been affected by. Works in conjunction with Union of Blood, (yields Still Beating Heart), Constrict, (yields Twitching Muscle), Exploding or Bursting Cyst (yields Quivering Brain) and Blood Letting Ritual (yields Pulsating Stomach).
prose_evidence.source_html: Harvests an organ out of a living body. Harvests different organs based on what your opponent has been affected by. prose_evidence.text_as_printed: Attaches a controlling symbiote to an opponent forcing them to obey your commands for 15 seconds. Repeated symbiote uses will be ignored completely. Draconic, undead, construct, and elemental targets are immune to suggestion.
prose_evidence.source_html: Attaches a controlling symbiote to an opponent forcing them to obey your commands for 15 seconds. Repeated symbiote uses will be ignored completely. Draconic, undead, construct, and elemental targets are immune to suggestion.

prose_evidence.text_as_printed: Attaches a symbiote to an ally, cleansing their body of poison and disease over 15 minutes. While most symbiotes will overwrite each other, this one will not. It can be casted in addition to others that are already on a player.
prose_evidence.source_html: Attaches a symbiote to an ally, cleansing their body of poison and disease over 15 minutes. While most symbiotes will overwrite each other, this one will not. It can be casted in addition to others that are already on a player.

prose_evidence.text_as_printed: Attaches a played symbiote to an ally, transforming their skin into spiky plates that reflect 1 damage upon their attackers for 1 hour.
prose_evidence.source_html: Attaches a played symbiote to an ally, transforming their skin into spiky plates that reflect 1 damage upon their attackers for 1 hour.

prose_evidence.text_as_printed: This attaches a Conducive Symbiote on you or a player. This symbiote lives on you and grants you an ability to use. Ability Granted: Conduct Spell, this is a spell you must hotkey to use. It grants you the ability to cast an instant heal (base 1157 depending on your focus will be more) Lev 42 to make, refresh is 45 seconds. Range is 30 m.

prose_evidence.text_as_printed: Casted on self or others, gives player levitate for one hour.
prose_evidence.source_html: Casted on self or others, gives player levitate for one hour.

prose_evidence.text_as_printed: Gives the player 5% chance to be healed for 1036 (base heals depending on focus) for over 6 seconds. Lasts 30 mins.
prose_evidence.source_html: Gives the player 5% chance to be healed for 1036 (base heals depending on focus) for over 6 seconds. Lasts 30 mins.

prose_evidence.text_as_printed: This is the most asked for symbiote by other players as it increases their base damage for one hour. (depending on the level casted.)
prose_evidence.source_html: This is the most asked for symbiote by other players as it increases their base damage for one hour. (depending on the level casted.)

prose_evidence.text_as_printed: This is the second most asked for symbiote by players. Very popular for it’s burst damage increase. This symbiote gives the player the ability to cast this as a spell. Found in their spell book, called Quickening Jolt, it must be hot keyed on the UI to be utilized. It doubles the damage output for 8 seconds. 5 minute refresh before and after using. Lasts for 1 hour.
